items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium, which could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. It includes fixes for CVE-2026-103849, CVE-2026-92909, and several XSS issues.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 10.0) unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) flaw in Magento and Adobe Commerce, fixed in APSB26-153 but requiring a manual patch, with new installations remaining vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Users are advised to also apply the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 separately.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 10.0) zero-day remote code execution vulnerability actively exploited in the wild, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) and stored XSS issues, which could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated customer account takeover
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 9.1) incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Exploitation attempts were observed in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: An Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability (CWE-116) allowing unauthenticated attackers to trigger arbitrary code execution over the network against exposed Adobe Commerce and Magento storefronts. Adobe published remediation guidance in security bulletin APSB26-73.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 6 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a significant security update for numerous Magento extensions, addressing six critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution, account takeover, admin login bypass, and payment fraud.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
